title: dont-stop-ask question set
description: A spoiler-free question graph emitted by the dont-stop-research skill. Contains visibility:both fields only — the spoiler fields (why_this, they_might_say, teach-back signatures and follow-ups) MUST NOT appear in a document conforming to this schema, because this is the surface the researcher works from.

researcher.description: Short description of who the set is for, or Anonymous. Avoid identifying detail in files intended for publication.

context.description: What the reader already knows, as supplied. Difficulty ratings are relative to this.

mode.description: solo: the researcher works alone. guided: a second person is supporting them.

generated_by.description: Skill name and version, e.g. dont-stop-research v1.0

status.description: draft means nobody has looked the set over yet. Consumers should surface this, not hide it.

original_question.description: Verbatim, as the question was first asked

triage_summary.description: Plain statement of what changed and why. The full six-criteria record lives in the markdown artifact.

purpose.description: Why the question is being asked, and any deadline

expansions.description: One entry per expansion cluster, in generation order

node.description: Id of the node that was expanded

working_question.description: The cluster's working question — normally the expanded node's question

note.description: Conventionally records that triage was inherited and that relevance groups are relative to this cluster

pruned.description: What a reader deleted by hand, in the order it happened: a question id, or 'Q3/S2' for one reading on one card. Its presence means the set was thinned deliberately, so full ladder coverage becomes advisory rather than required. Generated sets carry no such record and stay strictly checked.

staleness_note.description: Advisory only. What would make this set stale and when.

root.description: The centre node of the graph — the working question itself

label.description: Short display label, a few words

note.description: One or two sentences on how the question was sharpened

id.description: Q1-Q9 for a first-pass set; E1-E9, F1-F9 for successive expansions

parent.description: root, or the id of the node this card expands

question.description: The question in full, in plain language — no field jargon the reader has not met yet

label.description: Short display label for the graph node, a few words

move.description: The Paul & Elder move, or the elaborative form for Mechanism cards

relevance_group.description: Distance from the working question, NOT difficulty

difficulty.description: Coarse three-way rating for sorting and colour-coding. Does not replace level.

load_bearing.description: True for the Tension card the set is built around, and for the hardest card

readings.description: One to three ranked readings. Empty array means a thinking-only card, and single_reading_reason must then explain it.

source.description: Id of an entry in sources

single_reading_reason.description: Required when readings has fewer than two entries: why one (or none) suffices

check_first.description: A lateral-reading move the reader performs BEFORE reading. Never a verdict about the source.

read_for.description: A pointer into the text. Never a summary of it.

level.description: Prose naming the primary complexity challenge and a realistic time

url.description: A real URL that was checked. Omit rather than guess.

reachable_at.description: Used when there is no single URL: a searchable description of where to find it

verified_how.description: What was checked and against what

unconfirmed_detail.description: REQUIRED when verified is unconfirmed: exactly what could not be confirmed and what to check

paired_with.description: REQUIRED when access_tier is T4: a free route to the same argument

teach_back.description: Question text only. The telling/building signatures and follow-ups are spoiler fields and MUST NOT appear here.

question.description: Askable cold by anyone with zero subject knowledge
